paragraphs.text: I am applying to {company} as a {role}. My coursework in research methods, statistics and public policy included a capstone on library access, and my project work developed my interest in transparent methods.

During my Civic Example Lab placement, I reviewed 24 public reports and compared their coverage, definitions and collection methods. I drafted a methods note explaining missing values and the limits of cross-area comparisons.

In a library attendance study, I built a Python prototype and compared it with a prior-week baseline; held-out error was 18% lower. I documented data exclusions and baseline assumptions so readers could distinguish observation from interpretation.
I would contribute my Python and spreadsheet experience, public-source research and analytical writing to your research work.
